_comment: Copy this file to settings.json and fill in the blanks. settings.json is git-ignored.
_lease_scan_comment: Photo scan on New lease. Put your Claude API key in anthropic_api_key in config/settings.json (git-ignored), or set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Pages are sent to the Claude API and kept in data/scans/.
_drafts_comment: Custom messages: one message per ad, written in Stefan's style from his past messages. samples_path is a folder of .txt/.md/.eml files (one message per file, or several split by a line of ---), relative to rentals-desk/ or absolute. provider: "" (templates only), "lmstudio" (local, LM Studio's server on this Mac, nothing leaves it) or "claude" (the ad and the samples go to the Claude API; uses anthropic_api_key). auto writes the message when an ad is opened. Each message is written with one way of opening from config/approaches.json, and the desk leans toward the ones landlords answer most (see learn below). Once an approach has proven_min answered messages, up to proven_max of them (as Stefan sent them) are shown to the model as examples of that approach. Stefan still reads and approves every message.

kijiji._comment: Whole locations, newest first, read until caught up with what the desk has seen (max_pages_per_search caps it). No sort/address/ll/radius parameters: Kijiji's robots.txt asks robots not to use them, and the area check sorts ads into areas anyway.

_sources_comment: Routes the desk uses. 'alerts' reads Stefan's own saved-search emails and is always on. The six scanners (kijiji, craigslist, logisquebec, livrent, appartogo, lespac) are listed here but read nothing until that board's entry under 'permissions' is turned on. Facebook, Rentals.ca, PadMapper/Zumper and Louer.ca have no scanner: email alerts where the board offers them, the capture button otherwise. See SCANNER-LAUNCH.md.
_permissions_comment: One entry per scanner. A board is read only when scan_enabled is true AND letter names the board's written permission (file path or email subject and date) AND expires (YYYY-MM-DD, optional) has not passed. Copy the limits the letter sets: max_requests_per_hour caps requests per board per hour, min_interval_seconds spaces requests to its site. Nesi turns scan_enabled on, in config/settings.json, once the permission is given. If the letter itself is not filed yet, letter holds the statement the permission rests on (who, where, date) and letter_pending is true: the board is read and the desk shows 'Permission letter pending'. When the letter is filed, put its path in letter and set letter_pending to false. allow_contact_capture (default false) lets the desk keep landlords' phone numbers from that board (see contacts below). Turn it on only when the permission covers collecting contact details, and say where in contact_basis: the desk ignores the flag while contact_basis is empty.

details._comment: Boards whose ads the desk opens for their full text, because their search pages carry little. Only ads without full text yet, new ones first, at most max_per_run per board per read. Phone numbers and emails are blanked out of every scanned ad's stored title and text (on boards with allow_contact_capture the numbers are kept apart, on the lead).

contacts._comment: Landlord phone numbers, only on boards whose permissions entry has allow_contact_capture and a contact_basis. Numbers printed in the ad's own text are kept as each ad is read. reveal lists boards whose ad pages hide the number behind a button (its label, a regular expression) that the desk may click in a local browser (Playwright: python3 -m pip install playwright, then python3 -m playwright install chromium), for ads waiting in review with no number yet: only on boards just read, at most max_reveals_per_run per board per read, at least min_interval_seconds apart (more if the permission or robots.txt asks), counted against the permission's max_requests_per_hour. It obeys robots.txt and the board's cool-offs, never signs in, and at any CAPTCHA, bot check or sign-in it stops the reveal on that board for blocked_days and keeps nothing from that page. Numbers stay in data/desk.sqlite3 on this computer.

phone_search._comment: A web search for each landlord number the desk captures; a number found on a brokerage or listing site, or next to broker wording, adds a 'Likely broker' flag. Uses an official search API, never Google's own pages (they forbid automated queries). provider: "" (off), "brave" (Brave Search API key from api.search.brave.com) or "google" (Programmable Search: API key plus engine id cx, search the whole web). Each number once, again after recheck_days, at most max_per_run per read, min_interval_seconds apart.

scan._comment: A board is read again only when its last good read is older than its freshness window (minutes). Requests to one host are at least min_interval_seconds apart (more if robots.txt sets a Crawl-delay), plus up to jitter x that at random.

alerts._comment: Saved-search alert emails from the boards. Either drop .eml files in data/inbox/, or fill in imap to read one mailbox folder read-only (password in the macOS keychain under keychain_service). See README, Email alerts.

_learn_comment: How the desk reads results. min_sample: how many decisions (or, per approach, messages with a known outcome) before a finding stops being tentative and drafting leans on it; min_show: fewer than this is not reported. no_reply_days: a sent message with nothing marked after this many days counts as no reply. lean_light / lean_full: how much of the choice of approach follows the results (the rest is an even split) before and after every active approach has min_sample outcomes; keep lean_full under 1 so every approach stays tested. outcome_worth: the credit each outcome gives an approach (no reply and said no give 0). desk_test: the plan's test, messages sent and the signed listings that mean success or stop.
